description: Free request form for data FilingDelta doesn't cover yet (a ticker, central bank or release). Fields: what (required, up to 500 characters), price_usd (optional, what you would pay per card), frequency (optional), contact (optional, e.g. an email), wallet (optional 0x address). No links or HTML. Limits: 5 per hour per client, 20 per wallet per day. Returns {ok:true} when stored.
name: request_data
title: Request data we don't cover
